title: Puffco Pivot 3D Chamber – 2 Pack
description:
Pivot’s quick-release 3D Chamber 2-Pack ensures you’re ready for anything.

Preload the chambers before you head out, and pop on a fresh one with a twist whenever you need it. With Pivot’s innovative algorithm driving the experience, you get consistent temps, big vapor, and incredible flavor.

Features & Specs
Additional Details
Product Features:
– 3D Chamber technology
– Quick release design

What’s Included:
2 x Pivot 3D Chamber
